invalidation: Six ways this is wrong, and the first two are the serious ones. (1) MGC IS OUTSIDE ITS RTH. profiles.py puts MGC RTH at 08:20-13:30 and it is 18:45. CALLOUT.md is explicit: a callout outside a contract's RTH is outside everything this repository has ever measured. This is not a caveat, it is the single biggest weakness of the trade. (2) EVENING LIQUIDITY IS 10-27% OF NORMAL: the three evening 15m bars carry volume 1754, 1727 and 638 against an RTH-hours median of 6338. Thin tape widens slippage and makes a 4.40-point stop easier to wick through on nothing. (3) The reversal path is UNVALIDATED - never measured, and the desk's only reversal-gated trade today, CALL-0006, lost 1.021R. A gate returning YES is not evidence it should. (4) Limits on this desk are 0-for-3 on filling (N149/N151: a level superseded before price returns); a fourth miss is the likeliest single outcome. (5) MGC's DAILY and WEEKLY are NOT ELIGIBLE at all - the roll audit fails at p<0.0001 - so unlike MNQ there is no higher-frame check available in either direction, for or against. (6) Rule 7: sub-hourly is a graveyard and this is a 15m headline; rule 2 puts MTF alignment at z -4.09 and condition 5 is an alignment requirement, so the trade leans on the configuration the programme measured as worst.
